descriptionByLocale.en:
Role Purpose:

A Team Administrator leads the daily operations of the team and ensures service excellence for clients.

Key Responsibilities:

• Manage team of Client Service Associates (CSA) including; team schedule, preparation and review of client materials, monitor client and Financial Advisor requests and ensure timelines are met
• Oversee CSA operations including; client meeting preparation, input of orders and completion of associated documentation
• Educate clients on account services and capabilities and oversee the on boarding process for new clients*Provide support to Financial Advisors and act as a lead service provider for high priority relationships
Key Deliverables:
• Source and recruit CSAs to the team alongside being actively involved in the development of existing CSAs
• Prioritize account service requests and review daily reports and alerts to ensure appropriate delegation and completion
